title: Internal modules over an external ring
statement: Let $R$ be a ring and $C$ a category with finite products and a terminal object. An internal left $R$-module is an object $A$ with maps $A\times A\to A$, $*\to A$, $A\to A$ and $A\to A$ for each scalar in $R$, satisfying the abelian group and left module axioms as commutative diagrams. Equivalently the induced operations satisfy those axioms on every set $\operatorname{Hom}_C(T,A)$, for every object $T$. Morphisms commute with addition, zero, negation and every scalar map. These form a category with its forgetful functor to $C$.
